products.title: All Ireland Food Hamper
products.descriptionHtml:
All Ireland Food Hamper

Celebrate the very best of Ireland with our All Ireland Food Hamper, a delicious collection of much-loved Irish favourites, artisan treats and traditional flavours. Carefully selected to showcase the quality and variety of Irish food, this hamper makes a wonderful gift for anyone who loves a true taste of Ireland.

Inside, you’ll find:

  • McEntee’s Irish Tea – A comforting cup of traditional Irish tea, perfect for enjoying any time of the day.
  • Keogh’s Crisps – Deliciously crunchy Irish crisps, bringing a taste of Ireland’s famous potato-growing heritage to the hamper.
  • Coffee Perfection Coffee Bags – Convenient individual coffee bags for a rich and satisfying coffee wherever you are.
  • Hassets Biscuits & Crackers – A selection of delicious biscuits and savoury crackers, ideal for enjoying with tea, cheese or your favourite preserves.
  • Butlers Honeycomb Chocolates – Indulgent Irish chocolate treats with a delicious honeycomb centre, perfect for a little moment of luxury.
  • McDaid’s of Donegal Football Special & Banana Minerals – Two iconic Donegal favourites, bringing a nostalgic taste of Irish tradition to the collection.
  • Hadji Bey Fruit Jellies – Classic Irish confectionery with beautifully fruity flavours and a wonderfully traditional feel.
  • Janet’s Pizza Sauce – A tasty Irish-made sauce that adds rich flavour to homemade pizzas and other dishes.
  • Filligan’s of Donegal Mango Chutney – A deliciously fruity chutney with a touch of sweetness and spice.
  • Filligan’s of Donegal Chilli Jam – A sweet and gently fiery accompaniment that is perfect with cheese, meats or crackers.
  • Filligan’s of Donegal Raspberry Preserve – A deliciously fruity preserve, perfect on toast, scones, biscuits or simply enjoyed as a sweet treat.

From a warming cup of tea and freshly brewed coffee to crunchy crisps, traditional sweets, indulgent chocolates and delicious Donegal preserves, the All Ireland Food Hamper brings together a wonderful selection of Irish favourites in one memorable gift.

Perfect for birthdays, Christmas, corporate gifting, celebrations, or simply sending a little taste of Ireland to someone special.
